addons.description: An add-on for any program: two finishers a week of sled pushes and drags, car pushes and pulls, farmer's carries and atlas stones. Skipped in taper and test weeks.
addons.name: Strongman Conditioning

programs.description: Strength and size for men and women, two full-body days a week: a heavy top set and back-off sets on squat, bench, deadlift and press, then volume work for muscle. Same 12-week test calendar as the club.
programs.name: Powerbuilding 2-Day

programs.description: The Year 1 program in two days a week for men with less time: same cycles, deloads and test weeks, with a rotating variation standing in for the third day.
programs.name: RuskiMaxxing 2-Day Year 1

programs.description: The Year 1 program with the snatch and clean & jerk added: the five-lift supertotal plus the overhead press, three days a week.
programs.name: RuskiMaxxing Supertotal Year 1

programs.description: Beginner strength and mass year: three full-body days a week, plyometrics every session, four 12-week cycles that end in a max test. Squat, bench press, deadlift and overhead press.
programs.name: RuskiMaxxing Year 1

programs.description: Jim Wendler's 5/3/1 for men and women, four days a week: two leader cycles of 5's PRO and Boring But Big, then an anchor with all-out + sets, on the club's 12-week test calendar. Slow, steady progress that lasts for years.
programs.name: 5/3/1 Leader/Anchor

programs.description: Strength and size for men and women, upper/lower four days a week: each main lift heavy once a week with top and back-off sets, plus variation and accessory volume. Same 12-week test calendar as the club.
programs.name: Powerbuilding 4-Day

programs.description: Westside-style upper/lower: max-effort and dynamic-effort days for the lower and upper body, four days a week, on the same 12-week test calendar as Year 1.
programs.name: RuskiMaxxing 4-Day Conjugate Year 1

program.description: Beginner strength and mass year: three full-body days a week, plyometrics every session, four 12-week cycles that end in a max test. Squat, bench press, deadlift and overhead press.
program.name: RuskiMaxxing Year 1
